name: Shipment Entry
summary: CQRS-backed Volvo shipment entry now uses auto-saving expandable cards instead of a DataGrid, with add/remove/edit-part actions, inline quantity edits, discrepancy reporting, Infor Visual-backed part descriptions by part number, preview-email access for visible active shipment data, employee-number-backed persistence, a dedicated generated-label queue that stores one row per skid for LabelView review, shared MainWindow pane-footer access to open the configured Volvo label in LabelView, a generated-label review dialog with clear-to-history behavior, and archived history detail window parity.

workflowAreas: Preview email from active shipment cards
userActions: Edit part number or quantities inline
See the Infor Visual description for each displayed part number
Open the generated label data dialog and review one row per skid
Open the configured Volvo label in LabelView from the shared MainWindow footer
Preview the requisition email for the current visible shipment data
Clear generated label data into history from the review dialog
validationHints: Confirm adding or editing shipment cards refreshes the dedicated generated-label queue with one row per skid and quantity equal to quantity per skid
Confirm generated label rows use the Infor Visual-backed description when available and the saved shipment line fallback description otherwise
Confirm the View Label Data button opens the generated-label review dialog without changing the main shipment-entry layout
Confirm the generated-label review dialog shows Part ID, Quantity, Skid #, Total Skids, and Description for active label rows
Confirm clearing generated label data moves only the dedicated generated-label queue rows into generated-label history
Confirm the shared MainWindow Volvo label button launches LabelView when the Volvo label path is configured and redirects to Volvo label settings when it is not
Confirm Preview Email stays disabled until visible shipment cards exist and the current card data is valid for preview formatting
Confirm Preview Email opens the HTML email preview dialog from shipment entry without requiring shipment completion
Confirm active shipment cards and history detail cards show the Infor Visual part description for each part number when Visual data is available
Confirm pending shipment restore still rebuilds the same active cards
Confirm duplicate part numbers are blocked for both add and part-number change flows
Confirm quantity edits reject zero, negative, decimal, and non-integer values
Confirm discrepancy changes auto-save without blocking the user in a modal error flow
Confirm Complete Shipment still succeeds without being responsible for clearing the dedicated generated-label queue
Confirm archived history detail still loads after active rows are deleted
Confirm the archived history edit dialog remains read-only even though it reuses the shipment-entry edit surface
